result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations of the functional equation of the zeta function on the critical line $s=ti+\tfrac12$, Stirling-series asymptotics for $\log\Pi$, the phase $\vartheta$ of $\xi$, and a sum $\sum 1/\sqrt{n}\cos(\vartheta - t\log n)$ truncated at $m=\sqrt{t/2\pi}$.
result.transcription:
$\xi(s)\,\Pi(\tfrac{s}{2}-1)\,\pi^{-\frac{s}{2}}$

$\cos\frac{s\pi}{2}\,\Pi(s-1)\,\zeta(s) = (2\pi)^s\,\zeta(s-1)$ [?]

$s=ti+\frac12$

$\frac{e^{\frac{\pi}{2}t-\frac14\pi i}}{2}$

[-$\log\Pi(\ldots)$-] $s=ti+\frac12$

$\log\xi(ti-\tfrac12)-\tfrac14\pi i - ti\log 2\pi$ [?]

$\log\Pi(\frac{ti}{2}-\frac34)$ [-$+$-] $\log\Pi(\frac{ti}{4}+\frac12)$ [?]

$(\frac{ti}{2}-\frac14)\log(\frac{ti}{2}-\frac34)-\frac{ti}{2}+\frac34-\frac12\log\pi\,(ti+\tfrac12)$

$\log\frac{t}{2}+\frac{\pi i}{2}+\log(1-\frac{3}{2ti})$

$(\frac{ti}{2}-\frac14)\log\frac{t}{2}$ [-$+$-] $-\frac{t\pi}{4}-\frac{\pi i}{8}-\frac{ti}{2}-\log\pi(\frac{ti}{2}+\frac14)$

$i\left(\frac{t}{2}\log\frac{t}{2\pi}-\frac{\pi}{8}-\frac{t}{2}\right)-\frac{t\pi}{4}-\frac14\log\frac{t}{2}-\frac14\log\pi+\frac12\log 2\pi$

$i\left(\frac{t}{2}\log\frac{t}{2\pi}-\frac{t}{2}-\frac{\pi}{8}\right)-\frac{t\pi}{4}-\frac14\log\frac{t}{8\pi}$

$\log\Pi(s-1)-\log\Pi(ti-\tfrac12) = ti\log ti - ti+\frac12\log 2\pi-\frac{\mathfrak{A}}{1.2.2ti}+\frac{7\mathfrak{B}}{3.4.8(ti)^3}-\frac{31\mathfrak{C}}{5.6.32(ti)^5}$

$s\log 2\pi i = (ti+\tfrac12)$ [-$\log 2\pi \ldots$-] $\frac{t\pi}{2}+\frac{\pi}{4}i$

$i\left(t\log t-t-t\log 2\pi-\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\mathfrak{A}}{1.2.2t}+\frac{7\mathfrak{B}}{3.4.8t^3}+\frac{31\mathfrak{C}}{5.6.32t^5}\cdots\right)=2\vartheta i$

$\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}e^{-\log n\,ti+\vartheta i}$

$\sum_1^m\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\cos(\vartheta-t\log n)$

$x\log\frac{t}{2\pi}$ [-$\ldots$-] $=\pi$

$x=\frac{\pi}{\log\frac{t}{2\pi}}$

$m=\sqrt{\frac{t}{2\pi}}$

$\log m=\frac12\log\frac{t}{2\pi}$

methods.what: Functional equation of the zeta function in the form relating zeta(s) and zeta(1-s) via cos and Gamma (Pi)
Stirling asymptotic expansion of log Gamma on the critical line with Bernoulli-number coefficients
Asymptotic expansion of the phase (theta function) of zeta on the critical line
Asymptotic of log Gamma(s/2) term on critical line
Main sum of the approximate functional equation (Riemann–Siegel main term) truncated at m = sqrt(t/2pi)
Choice of truncation point m and spacing x
